newsitem.title: USA: Tyler Corp names Bruce Wilkinson CEO.
newsitem.headline: Tyler Corp names Bruce Wilkinson CEO.

text.p: Tyler Corp said Monday it has appointed Bruce Wilkinson, chief executive officer.

Wilkinson comes to Tyler after a six-month stint as interim chief executive officer of Proler International Corp, where he successfully negotiated the sale of the company to Schnitzer Steel Industries.
Wilkerson, said the company, takes over the position of CEO from C.A. Rundell, who remains with Tyler as chairman.
Tyler Corp provides products for fund-raising programs and retails automotive parts.
